description: Gear aggregation II (FAM-04): the second half of frmMain CalcCharacterStats (stealth, quests, accuracy, crits, MR, dodge, speed, tags)
notes: CalcCharacterStats is run whole from frmMain.frm (scenario key frm) and cut at its 'Call RefreshMagic' line: what follows is display and later cards. The appended lines copy locals into the tsProbe control: 0 nEncumPCT, 1 nWalkSpeed, 2 nDodgeValue, 3 nAccyCalc, 4 nCritBonus (after the tool-tip diminishing step).
stat = lblInvenCharStat(0..46).Caption, lbltags = their .Tag, tags = txtCharStats(0..5).Tag.
Inputs: chkCharQuests(0..11).Value, cmbCharQuestOpts(0..3).ListIndex, chkGlobalFilter.Value, nGlobalAttackTypeMME; the rest as in the gear family.
Rows numbered 9001 and up are invented (db_extra); data holds every row the cases use, for the Rust test.
